title: Why Does Ice Float? Water's Superpower Mystery!

lines.text: Drop a metal spoon in a cup of water—it sinks straight down like an anchor!
lines.caps: Drop a metal *SPOON | in a cup—it sinks straight down *LIKE | an *ANCHOR!

lines.text: Drop a solid cube of hard ice in—and it floats right to the surface!
lines.caps: Drop a solid cube of *ICE in— | and it floats right to the *TOP | *SURFACE!

lines.text: Almost everything in the universe gets heavier and denser when it freezes!
lines.caps: Almost everything in the *UNIVERSE | gets heavier and denser when it *FREEZES!

lines.text: Liquid wax sinks in liquid wax. Solid iron sinks in molten iron!
lines.caps: Liquid wax *SINKS. | Solid iron *SINKS | in molten *IRON!

lines.text: So why is water the magical exception on our planet?
lines.caps: So why is *WATER | the magical exception on our *WHOLE | *PLANET?

lines.text: When water freezes, molecules lock arms into an open, six-sided honeycomb crystal!
lines.caps: When water freezes, molecules lock *ARMS | into an open six-sided *HONEYCOMB | *CRYSTAL!

lines.text: This trapped empty space makes ice about nine percent lighter than liquid water!
lines.caps: This trapped space makes ice *NINE PERCENT | lighter than liquid *WATER!

lines.text: Because ice floats, frozen lake tops act as warm blankets so fish survive winter!
lines.caps: Because ice floats, lake *TOPS | act as warm blankets so fish *SURVIVE | *WINTER!
